description: At an outdoor hot spring in snowy mountains, with steam rising in the low winter sun, a young man stands waist-deep in the hot water, laughing, his arms flung wide as a pair of wooden crutches flies through the air above him and falls away. He then walks out through the water towards the camera on his own legs, laughing. Behind him other bathers in the pool raise their arms and cheer. Snow covers the stone edge and the pine trees, and monkeys sit on the roof of a wooden bathhouse.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er watet aus der heißen Quelle.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está saliendo de la fuente termal caminando por el agua.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il sort de la source chaude en pataugeant.
fr.question: Que fait le jeune homme ?
